sources.title: Legend7001/ec-lookup-copy · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A sequence that is an exact match in UniProt gets that entry's EC (lookup order: Swiss-Prot 2026_03, BRENDA 2026.1, TrEMBL). Only 8-byte hashes of those sequences are stored, in weights/ext_lookup.json.gz, ext_brenda.npz and ext_trembl.npz. This is external data and, for the validation set, leakage: UniProt holds 99.5% of the validation sequences.
